prompts.03-approach:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: a full-screen 16:10 WebGL background plate for a concept still of an existing personal website.
Input 1 is the actual website screenshot: preserve its dark atmosphere, tiny point-cloud material, blue/cyan/violet/magenta palette, and off-centre right-hand composition. Input 2 is the exact flower anatomy reference, NOT a request for a solid photographic surface. Use that particular hyacinth, its irregular blossoms, recurved bells, tall folded crown, veined petals, and connected stem.
Remove ALL text and navigation from the plate: the exact real website typography will be overlaid separately. NO words, letters, captions, labels, logos, cards, controls, browser frames, watermarks, or invented UI.
The image must look like a physically coherent real-time 3D rendering of the existing flower made entirely of countless fine, individually separated luminous points on anatomically curved surfaces. Accurate thickness, curled rims, visible undersides, foreshortening, changing occlusion, and coherent spatial scale. Preserve the observed blue-violet coloration, cyan vein lines and restrained highlights. Black space between fine dots; even near-camera petals remain dotted. Preserve the original airy granularity; no opaque smooth petals, solid plastic, glass, paint, clay, neon ribbons, point trails, generic abstract particles, or oversized spheres.
Keep the left 52% of the frame very dark and visually quiet as in the screenshot, for the actual unchanged website copy. All important petal forms and depth cues occupy the right half; forms may crop naturally at the right/top/bottom edge. Retain the original subtle dark-indigo atmospheric background and only a few faint ambient motes and very faint orbital arcs. No new scene, landscape, floor, pedestal or prop. Landscape 16:10, matching input1.
SCROLL SNAPSHOT: viewport 3 of a continuous descent. The camera has approached the exact upper-right bell and folded crown of the supplied flower on a shallow diagonal, about 25 degrees around from the original view. The upper flower has passed partly above the frame. A single distinctive recurved upper petal is large in the upper-right foreground; its bright cyan curled lip and shadowed blue-violet underside have tangible thickness. Smaller original blossoms overlap behind it and descend toward the lower-right edge. The subject fills roughly the right half of the frame from top to bottom. The original flower's irregular identity remains obvious. Realistic botanical form and precise perspective, rendered with the same tiny separated dots as the website. Quiet, rich dark negative space on the left.
